rules.summary: During a week when school is in session, minors under 16 may work at most 3 hours a day and 18 hours a week, outside school hours, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: MCL 409.110 — Youth Employment Standards Act, minors under 16
citation.excerpt: (b) For not more than 3 hours per day during a week when school is in session ... (e) For not more than 18 hours during a week when school is in session

rules.summary: During a week when school is not in session, minors under 16 may work at most 40 hours, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: MCL 409.110 — Youth Employment Standards Act, minors under 16
citation.excerpt: (c) Between the hours of 7 a.m. and 9 p.m. ... June 1 and ends on Labor Day ... (f) For not more than 40 hours during a week that is not a week when school is in session

rules.summary: Students 16 and 17 may work at most 24 hours in a school week, 10 hours a day (8 h daily average) and 6 days, between 6 a.m. and 10:30 p.m. (11:30 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays).

citation.title: MCL 409.111 — Youth Employment Standards Act, minors 16 and older
citation.excerpt: (e) If the minor is a student in school and school is in session, 24 hours in 1 week. (2) ... shall not employ a minor 16 years of age or older between 10:30 p.m. and 6 a.m.

rules.summary: When school is not in session, 16- and 17-year-olds may work at most 10 hours a day (8 h daily average), 48 hours and 6 days a week, between 6 a.m. and 11:30 p.m.

citation.title: MCL 409.111 — Youth Employment Standards Act, minors 16 and older
